scenario.situation: The student has been living in Jeddah for a few months and meets a Jeddawi friend at a café on the corniche to catch up.
scenario.otherRole: A close Jeddawi friend who wants to hear everything.
scenario.goalEnglish: Talk about your new flat and neighbours, a recent trip, how you feel about life in Jeddah, give your opinion on a new series, and make plans with conditions for next weekend.
